integrity: Proof and finite checks are provided. The result concerns a specific algorithmic failure event; priority remains subject to independent historical review.
scientific_limitations: Exact real arithmetic; diagonal flat-rank example; absolute Frobenius tolerance less than one; independent Gaussian sketch blocks; well-defined two-lookahead branch only. Does not cover premature first-stop branch, general matrices, alternative pruning tests, or numerical roundoff.
title: Exact false-pruning law and Gumbel boundary for adjoint-free Gaussian range finding
